verdicts.title: Topological Galois Theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce an abstract topos-theoretic framework for building Galois-type theories in a variety of different mathematical contexts; such theories are obtained from representations of certain atomic two-valued toposes as toposes of continuous actions of a topological group. Our framework subsumes in particular Grothendieck's Galois theory and allows to build Galois-type equivalences in new contexts, such as for example graph theory and finite group theory.

It shares only the broad 'Galois theory' vocabulary without engaging the specific claim.
